verified_design: Strict bounded JSON-v2 fields and scalar character controls; no model-selected script, import, operator, executable command or file path. Blender operations and output paths are fixed trusted implementation/host arguments.

Continuous canonical BODY uses fixed age/shape data, official arm/forearm/hand weights, and two-bone A-pose transforms; canonical deformation keeps BODY connected before any explicitly requested added body regions; there is no head/neck/hand skin splicing.
Head, eye and face controls use immutable aged anchors; below-hip limb warp is continuous. Tests check actual height/head-ratio and straight upper/forearm alignment at bounded limb/height cases.

Garment/hair patches retain shared clip-edge intersection vertices and explicitly close thickness; skin and every final accessory are checked for one component, edge/vertex manifold topology, positive signed volume and zero-area triangles.
Generic loft/cage/primitive route still uses bounded voxel fusion with remove_disconnected=false. Disconnected external bodies are refused; no largest-component or external-anatomy filtering exists.
Certified internal-negative-cavity utility remains separately adversarial-tested; final continuous-body production path performs no skin VDB and reports empty internal_voxel_fills.

Constrained triangulation preserves boundary edges and uses a validated interior Steiner point only when required; final topology is rechecked. Numerical vertex merging/dissolving and inserted triangulation vertices are disclosed in cleanup.

Original canonical source-plan digest is retained separately from expanded data digest. Ordinary fixed asset source hashes, actual age coefficient and requested/effective smoothing/subdivision/no-voxel semantics are exposed truthfully.
Plan, grid, vertex, triangle and GLB byte budgets are bounded; actual post-modifier geometry totals and data hash gate export. Existing output/receipt/render files are never overwritten.

limitations: Closed manifold and positive volume do not establish reference fidelity, all requested semantic features, photorealism, clothing-body collision freedom or absence of geometric self-intersections.
Source-normal clearance check covers raw patch generation; final Blender topology tests do not substitute for visible garment/scalp clearance under all shapes.
Generic voxel fusion can smooth or erase sub-resolution detail; actual organic output views and requested branch/arm counts still require separate inspection.
Character API covers bounded fixed A-pose/control ranges; review does not establish arbitrary pose, identity or hidden-surface reconstruction accuracy.
Mesh is static sculpt output; animation-ready retopology, skeleton/rig output and UV/texture fidelity are not established by this component review.

business_acceptance.note: Actual final-native image-to-mesh generation, realistic/stylized/organic results and multiview back/occluded reference agreement remain separate root responsibilities. Keep issue543 open until its full criteria are met.
